description: Update a work schedule (partial via PATCH). The API only supports changing the end date and the assignee here. Note: changing AssigneeUserKey reassigns every not-yet-started work item the schedule has generated — confirm with the user first.

ScheduleEndDate.description: ISO 8601 date to stop the schedule; pass null to clear the end date (run forever)

name: update_work_schedule
title: Update work schedule
